summary: Nunn has positioned himself as an unwavering defender of Israel, co-leading a 2023 House resolution demanding immediate U.S. intelligence, diplomatic, and military support and writing in a 2023 blog that he “will never waver.” His October 2024 statement again demanded unwavering U.S. support and cited Iron Dome replenishment. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090, applying the IHRA definition to Title VI education enforcement. His documented statements consistently frame the conflict through Israeli security needs.
